purpose: Provenance and rights records for assets acquired for the AI Curriculum Cinematic Experience (Phases 0-6). Photography provenance stays in manifest.json; this file covers 3D models, 2D illustrations, and animation assets. Policy inherited from manifest.json.

policy.authenticity: Illustrations must not be presented as real Bhavya participants, students, or team members. No stock/generated people as Bhavya participants.
policy.naming: Honest basenames only; original source filenames preserved minus CDN hash prefixes.
policy.unverified_sources: Sources not verifiable by direct fetch are recorded BLOCKED or UNVERIFIED and never cited as authority.

required_human_steps: Enable R2 in the Cloudflare Dashboard (account home -> R2).
Run `npx wrangler login` (from apps/ai-institute) and approve.
Then: npx wrangler r2 bucket create bhavya-ai-assets (if missing)
Then: npx wrangler r2 object put bhavya-ai-assets/3d/<file> --file=assets/3d/<file> per large asset
